marginalia.note: In commentario de reb. Indicis & Iaponicis anno 1574. Coloniae edite.

page.notes: The marginal note "dite." after "quos" is the end of the note "Coloniae edite." at the start of the paragraph; it is shown there once. The margin note "fol. 241. & 424." is partly faded and its numerals are doubtful. The word "Iniesuanatus" in italics is uncertain. "parentibus" is partly faded in the scan. No catchword is visible.
